# Prep

```{r edger-prep, eval = T, echo = T, cache = F}
#library(edgeR)
## https://github.com/bartongroup/profDGE48/blob/master/DE_tool_scripts/edgeR.R
## https://support.bioconductor.org/p/84338/
## https://support.bioconductor.org/p/84291/#84292
## https://bioconductor.statistik.tu-dortmund.de/packages/3.6/bioc/vignettes/tximport/inst/doc/tximport.html#edger
## and edgeR user's guide: https://web.stanford.edu/class/bios221/labs/rnaseq/lab_4_rnaseq.html
## Make table for tximport: transcript to Gene map: https://bioconductor.org/packages/devel/bioc/vignettes/tximport/inst/doc/tximport.html#edgeR
if(subs == 'host'){
tx_to_gene <- annot |> 
  dplyr::select(tx_id, ensembl_gene_id,rowLabel, tx_name,everything())
(dup_annot <- tx_to_gene |> group_by(ensembl_gene_id) |> tally() |> filter(n>1) |> pull(ensembl_gene_id))
#tx_to_gene <- annot |> 
#  dplyr::select(tx_id, locus_tag,rowLabel, tx_name, NrTranscripts,everything())

remove(annot)
gc()
}else{
tx_to_gene <- annot |> 
  mutate(ensembl_gene_id = locus_tag) |>
  dplyr::select(tx_id, ensembl_gene_id, locus_tag, rowLabel, everything())
}

if(TRUE){
txi <- tximport::tximport(salmon_files, 
        type = "salmon", 
        tx2gene = tx_to_gene[,1:2])
saveRDS(txi, file = paste0(res_path, "txi", ext, ".rds"))

}else{
txi<-readRDS(file = paste0(res_path, "txi", ext, ".rds"))
}
cts <- txi$counts
normMat <- txi$length
## Obtaining per-observation scaling factors for length, adjusted to avoid changing the magnitude of the counts.
normMat <- normMat/exp(rowMeans(log(normMat)))
normCts <- cts/normMat
## Computing effective library sizes from scaled counts, to account for composition biases between samples.
eff.lib <- calcNormFactors(normCts) * colSums(normCts)
## Combining effective library sizes with the length factors, and calculating offsets for a log-link GLM.
normMat <- sweep(normMat, 2, eff.lib, "*")
normMat <- log(normMat)

## Creating a DGEList object for use in edgeR.
y <- DGEList(cts)
y <- scaleOffset(y, normMat)
```

```{r, edgeR-QC-lib, fig.width=12}
cpm_log <- cpm(y$counts, log = TRUE)
if(subs == 'virus'){
colnames(cpm_log)<-gsub("_inf_", "_", colnames(cpm_log))
}
dmat<-round(stats::cor(cpm_log, method = "spearman"),4)

#Transform the scale from correlations
ddist<-round((-(dmat-1)/2),4)
ddist<-as.dist(ddist)
pheatmap1<-MyPheatmapDist(dmat,color = prgn, main = "Correlation of log(CPM), unfiltered genes", clustering_distance_cols = ddist , clustering_distance_rows = ddist)
save_pheatmap_png(pheatmap1,paste0(res_path, "figs/edgeR_heatmap1_cpmLog_corr_BefFilt", ext, ".png"), width=1600)

library("PoiClaClu") # heatmaps using poisson distance instead
if(sampSet != "39samp"){
poisd <- PoissonDistance(t(cts), type = 'deseq')
}else{
poisd <- PoissonDistance(t(cts), type = 'mle')
}
samplePoisDistMatrix <- as.matrix( poisd$dd )
rownames(samplePoisDistMatrix)<-colnames(normMat)
colnames(samplePoisDistMatrix)<-colnames(normMat)
ppois_g<-MyPheatmapDist(samplePoisDistMatrix,
         clustering_distance_rows=poisd$dd,
         clustering_distance_cols=poisd$dd, main = "Poisson distance of raw counts, unfiltered genes")
save_pheatmap_png(ppois_g,paste0(res_path, "figs/edgeR_heatmap2_PoisDistRaw_BefFilt", ext, ".png"), width=1600)

metadata <- data.frame(row.names = colnames(cpm_log))
metadata$trt_vir<-coldata$trt_vir
metadata$timePt <- coldata$timePt

if(subs == 'virus'){
nprop <-0.95
}else{
nprop<-0.50
}
ntop <- round(nprop*nrow(cpm_log))
p <- PCAtools::pca(
            mat = cpm_log,
            metadata = metadata,

rownames(p$loadings) <- as_tibble(rownames(p$loadings)) |>
  setNames("ensembl_gene_id") |>
```

## QC after filtering out genes

```{r, edgeR-filt, fig.width=12}

## Specify design ----
if(TRUE){
#design <- model.matrix(~0 + batch + condition, data = coldata)
#design <- model.matrix(~0 + condition + batch, data = coldata)
group <- fct_inorder(coldata$condition)
design <- model.matrix(~0 + group)
#colnames(design) <- sub("batch", "", colnames(design))
#colnames(design) <- sub("condition", "", colnames(design))
colnames(design) <- sub("group", "", colnames(design))
colnames(design)
y$samples$group<-group
# filtering using the design information
#if(!(identical(coldata$names, colnames(design)))){stop("!!")}
keep <- filterByExpr(y, design)
##sanity check
#tx_to_gene |> filter(ensembl_gene_id %in% names(which(keep))) |> group_by(tx_id) |> tally(sort=T)
table(keep)
y2 <- y[keep, ]
cat('Filtered out ', nrow(y)-nrow(y2),  'genes, ', nrow(y2), ' genes are left.', 
'\n')

saveRDS(keep, paste0(res_path, "edgeR-keep", ext, ".rds"))
saveRDS(y2,  paste0(res_path, "FiltObj", ext, ".rds"))

  sizeLoadingsNames = 2,
  title = "Not so pretty PCA"
)

  p,
  showLoadings = T,
  x = "PC1",
  y = "PC2",
  colby = 'trt_vir',
  shape = 'timePt',
  # to change shape by levels of an additional factor
  legendPosition = 'right',
  labSize = 2,
  pointSize = 2,
  sizeLoadingsNames = 2,
  ntopLoadings = 3,
  title = "Not so pretty PCA"
)

print(ppca0a)
print(ppca0b)
dev.off()
ppca0a
ppca0b
}
```

# GLM

```{r, edgeR-glm}
## Run edgeR

## Estimate Dispersions
#remove(y) #to avoid confusion
(y2 <- estimateDisp(y2, design))
mybcv<-round(sqrt(y2$common.dispersion), 4)
cat(paste0("BCV is ",mybcv, "\n" ))
fit <- glmQLFit(y2, design, robust = TRUE)


#biological CV
pdf(paste0(res_path, "figs/edgeR_bcv_and_qldisp", ext, ".pdf"))
#the red line is sqrt(y$common.dispersion)
#p51: https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/vignettes/edgeR/inst/doc/edgeRUsersGuide.pdf
plotBCV(y2)
#The QL dispersions can be estimated using the glmQLFit function, and then be visualized with the plotQLDisp function.
plotQLDisp(fit)
dev.off()
plotBCV(y2)
plotQLDisp(fit)

## Test for all
## https://github.com/gutierrez-arcelus-lab/bcellactivation/blob/master/bcell_lowinput/edger_diffexpr.R
gs <- colnames(design)

combinations <- combn(seq_len(length(gs)), 2)
if(TRUE){ # run glmTREAT() for host to narrow down DE gene list
if(subs == 'host'){
lfc <-  log2(1.5) #fold effect of |1.5|
}else{
lfc <-NULL
}
(lfc)
run_qlf <- function(i, alpha2 = 0.05) {

    comb_i <- combinations[ , i]
    contrasts_i <- rep(0, length(gs)) 
    contrasts_i[comb_i[1]] <- -1 #control
    contrasts_i[comb_i[2]] <- 1 #exp
    if(is_null(lfc)){
    qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrasts_i)
    print(summary(decideTests(qlf, contrast=contrasts_i, adjust.method = 'BH',p.value = alpha2, lfc = 0)))
    res <- 
	topTags(qlf, n = Inf, p.value = alpha2) |> 
	as.data.frame() |>
	as_tibble(rownames = "locus_tag")
    }else{
    tr <- glmTreat(fit, contrast=contrasts_i, lfc = lfc)
    print(summary(decideTests(tr, contrast=contrasts_i, adjust.method = 'BH',p.value = alpha2, lfc = lfc)))
    
  
    res <- 
	topTags(tr, n = Inf, p.value = alpha2) |> 
	as.data.frame() |>
	as_tibble(rownames = "locus_tag")
}
    if (nrow(res) > 0) {

	res |>
	    mutate(group1 = gs[comb_i[2]], 
	           group2 = gs[comb_i[1]]) |>
	    dplyr::select(group1, group2, everything())

    } else {
	tibble(group1 = gs[comb_i[2]], group2 = gs[comb_i[1]])
    }

    }



library(furrr)
conflicts_prefer(future::plan)
#plan(multisession, workers = parallelly::availableCores())
plan(multisession, workers = 4)
#pdf(paste0(res_path, "GLM_plotMDp0.05", ext, ".pdf"))
qlf_all <- 
    future_map_dfr(1:ncol(combinations), run_qlf) 
gc()
#dev.off()
qlf_all<-qlf_all |> 
  mutate(contrast = paste0(qlf_all$group1, "v", qlf_all$group2)) 

conts_of_interest<-c(paste0("HHQ_inf_t", 1:4, "vHHQ_cntl_t", 1:4),
      paste0("DMSO_inf_t", 1:4, "vDMSO_cntl_t", 1:4),
       paste0("HHQ_cntl_t", 1:4, "vDMSO_cntl_t", 1:4),
      paste0("HHQ_inf_t", 1:4, "vDMSO_inf_t", 1:4)
     )   


qlf_all<-qlf_all |>
    left_join(distinct(tx_to_gene, locus_tag, rowLabel), by = "locus_tag") 

qlf_all <- qlf_all |>
    select(group1, group2, contrast, locus_tag, everything())

qlf_all <- qlf_all |> 
  mutate(DIR = ifelse(logFC >0, "UP", ifelse(logFC < 0, "DOWN", NA)))


qlf_all<-qlf_all |> dplyr::filter(contrast %in% conts_of_interest)
qlf_all |> group_by(contrast) |>tally(sort=T)
qlf_all |> group_by(contrast, DIR) |> tally(sort=T)
   
qlf_all<-na.omit(qlf_all)
qlf_all<-qlf_all |> group_by(contrast) |> arrange(FDR)
#qlf_all<-na.omit(qlf_all)
write_tsv(qlf_all, paste0(res_path, "tables/edgeR-GLM_DiffExpr_AllContrastsp0.05.tsv"))
system(paste0("gzip -f ", res_path, "tables/edgeR-GLM_DiffExpr_AllContrastsp0.05.tsv"))
}else{
qlf_all<-read_tsv(paste0(res_path, "tables/edgeR-GLM_DiffExpr_AllContrastsp0.05.tsv.gz"))  
}
          
qlf_all |>  
  #filter(contrast %in% conts_of_interest) |>
  group_by(contrast, .drop = FALSE) |>

  gt()
```

```{r, edgeR-lrt}
#gs <- colnames(design)
#combinations <- combn(seq_len(length(gs)), 2)
design2 <- model.matrix(~0+group)
colnames(design2) <- sub("group", "", colnames(design2))
colnames(design2)
gs2<-colnames(design2)
combinations2 <- combn(seq_len(length(gs)), 2)
#LRT
if(TRUE){ #run once
fitLRT <- glmFit(y2, design2, robust=TRUE)
run_lrt <- function(i, alpha2 = 0.05) {
    
    comb_i <- combinations[ , i]
    contrasts_i <- rep(0, length(gs)) 
    contrasts_i[comb_i[1]] <- -1 #control
    contrasts_i[comb_i[2]] <- 1 #exp

   lrt <- glmLRT(fitLRT, contrast = contrasts_i)
    print(summary(decideTests(lrt, contrast=contrasts_i, adjust.method = 'BH',p.value = alpha2, lfc = 0)))
    #pdf(paste0(res_path, "LRT_plotMD_", gs[comb_i[1]], "v", gs[comb_i[2]], ext, ".pdf"))
  #plotMD(lrt,bg.pch=1, bg.cex=0.5,contrast = contrasts_i, ylim = c(-3,3))
 # abline(h=c(0.5,-0.5),col="dodgerblue")
  #abline(h=c(1,-1),col="#D55E00", lty = 2)
  #dev.off()
    res <- 
	topTags(lrt, n = Inf, p.value = alpha2) |> 
	as.data.frame() |>
	as_tibble(rownames = "locus_tag")

    if (nrow(res) > 0) {

	res |>
	    mutate(group1 = gs2[comb_i[2]], group2 = gs2[comb_i[1]]) |>
	    select(group1, group2, everything())

    } else {
	
	tibble(group1 = gs2[comb_i[2]], group2 = gs2[comb_i[1]])
    }

}
```

```{r, edgeR-compare}
  splits<-SplitContrastName(contrast = subsetCL[s])
```
